rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP, matched to a single user, and accessed only that user’s orders. It reviewed the order and product options via read-only tools, then requested and received explicit confirmation before attempting any order-changing action. When the first exchange attempt failed due to insufficient gift card balance, the agent correctly informed the user and offered compliant alternatives within budget. The user then confirmed the new selections, and the agent proceeded. No unauthorized writes occurred; confirmation was obtained before each attempted change. Final information (exchange initiated, refund of price difference to gift card, return instructions via email) is consistent with typical exchange flow and there were no contradictory tool errors. Minor ambiguity exists because the successful exchange tool response echoed original order details rather than an explicit exchange confirmation, but no evidence indicates an incorrect or unauthorized action. Overall, the interaction meets policy requirements.
